meta.name: clarify
meta.description: Improve unclear UX copy, error messages, microcopy, labels, and instructions. Makes interfaces easier to understand and use.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 优化界面文案,让用户更容易理解和使用
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你经常需要打磨产品中的文字表达
copy.tagline_en: Polish interface copy to make it clearer and more user-friendly
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often need to refine text in your product

howto.what: Claude 会分析并改写界面中的模糊文案，如错误提示、按钮标签、表单说明等，使其更清晰易懂。
howto.when: 当你提供一段需要改进的界面文本，或描述某个功能/组件时触发。

say.text: 帮我改一下这个错误提示：'Error 403: Forbidden'
say.note: Claude 会给出更友好的版本。

say.text: 这个按钮标签'Submit'不够明确，怎么改？
say.note: Claude 会建议更具体的动作描述。

howto.what_en: Claude analyzes and rewrites unclear interface text such as error messages, button labels, and form instructions to make them clearer and more user-friendly.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you provide a piece of interface text that needs improvement or describe a feature/component with unclear copy.

say_en.text: Help me improve this error message: 'Error 403: Forbidden'
say_en.note: Claude will suggest a friendlier version.

say_en.text: This button label 'Submit' is vague, how should I change it?
say_en.note: Claude will recommend a more specific action.
